title: Human Behavior Analysis: A Comprehensive Survey on Techniques, Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions
authors: Essahraui, S.; Lamaakal, I.; Maleh, Y.; El Makkaoui, K.; Bouami, M. F.; Ouahbi, I.; Abd El-Latif, A. A.; Almousa, M.; Rodrigues, J. J. P. C.
tldr: Comprehensive survey of Human Behavior Analysis covering AI-driven methods from deep learning, NLP, and computer vision across healthcare, marketing, education, and criminal justice domains.
problem_and_motivation: Human Behavior Analysis is a rapidly growing interdisciplinary field combining psychology, sociology, AI, and data science, but existing literature lacks a comprehensive survey covering techniques, applications, challenges, and future directions across domains.
approach: Comprehensive survey of Human Behavior Analysis techniques from manual observation to AI-driven methods.
Explores deep learning, NLP, and computer vision approaches for behavior analysis.
Covers applications in healthcare, marketing, education, workplace productivity, activity recognition, and criminal justice.
Discusses data sources: sensor data, social media, physiological signals, and multimodal analysis.
Examines challenges: data privacy, generalization, real-time processing, scalability.
findings: AI-driven methods such as deep learning, NLP, and computer vision dominate modern HBA approaches.
HBA enhances outcomes across healthcare, marketing, education, and criminal justice.
Major challenges include data privacy, generalization across populations, and real-time processing requirements.
Emerging trends include edge computing, Large Language Models, and privacy-preserving techniques.

definitions.definition: Interdisciplinary field combining psychology, sociology, AI, and data science to model, understand, and predict human behavior.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: Provides a holistic review of HBA spanning traditional to AI-driven techniques across multiple domains. Highlights emerging trends including LLMs and privacy-preserving methods for future research.
directly_justifies: HBA enhances decision-making across healthcare, marketing, education, and criminal justice.
Data privacy is a major challenge for HBA deployment.
limits: Survey covers HBA broadly, not specifically personal finance.
Limited depth on financial behavior analysis specifically.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: Systematic scan across all 14 domains. Flagged 5.A, 6.A, 10.A (medium), 8.A (low). Rejected Philippine-specific and budgeting-specific topics as this is a general HBA survey.

limitations: Broad survey limited depth in any specific domain.
Financial behavior analysis not a primary focus.
remember_this: AI-driven methods dominate modern Human Behavior Analysis.
Edge computing and LLMs are emerging HBA trends.
Data privacy remains a major HBA challenge.
